purpose: Section 4.5.6 direct ADC-injection physical FM demodulation tests

generator_CH1.provenance: Instructed intended setup; user tentatively confirmed everything set. Detailed instrument readbacks not independently supplied.

generator_CH2.offset_setting_V: initial +2.5 V instructed; actual readback not supplied

setup.speaker: Remains connected per established setup; actual impedance/load not measured
setup.scope_CH1: R1 100 ohm / C2 470 nF junction to circuit ground, after GP16 coupling capacitor; instructed probe point, not independently physically inspected
setup.input_limit_result: Reported GP27 extrema within 0 to 3.3 V; GP26 near midscale. Does not exclude all transients.

observations.note: Clear peak; later user said an earlier reading might have been misread, unspecified which.

observations.condition: FM off, carrier retained as instructed
observations.note: Peak disappeared; level is background at 500 Hz, not resolved residual tone.
Measured at 500 Hz FFT location; repeated at same reported level.
Approximate reading, final repeat confirmed yes to approximately -48 dBm.

tone_recovery.verdict: Meets proposed bench frequency target as reported; modulation-off disappearance supports recovery from FM. Cursor accuracy/calibration not independently established.

modulation_off.verdict: Supports target under unchanged settings; residual tone not resolved. 33 dB is nominal peak/background separation, not exact residual-tone suppression. Initial reading uncertainty retained; later -48 dBm reference is not silently substituted.

deviation_response.repeatability: Both conditions repeated at reported precision. Earlier initial higher-deviation level -50 dBm is retained as uncertain.
deviation_response.verdict: Increasing response approximately near doubling; 2.24x measured vs 2x ideal (~12% high). No exact proportionality or no-compression claim; uncertainty/tolerance not quantified.

pre_test_rail_history.interpretation: Counter increased during the setup/physical-test session before the final timed window. No continuous log identifies when or why; do not attribute all to a specific wiring change or silently claim zero near-rail events over the entire session.
